# Critical config watcher. No regex needed.
#   [Section]          -> watch EVERY key inside that section
#   [Section] KeyName  -> watch one literal key (case-insensitive)
# Any added / removed / changed key in a watched scope raises the warning banner
# in both the GitHub release body and the Discord announcement.
# This intentionally includes preference keys; that is the maintainer's choice.
